extracted.intended_audience: patent attorneys, agents, USPTO examiners, and third-party requesters involved in citation of prior art and ex parte reexamination practice
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for citation of prior art and procedures for requesting, processing, and conducting ex parte reexamination proceedings under 35 U.S.C. (MPEP Chapter 2200). Covers who may file, content and timing requirements, processing, decisions, appeals, and related procedural matters.
